rationale: For an Indonesian family management app (Famly), a warm, organic, earthy aesthetic establishes trust (for finances) and approachability (for chores and family members). It leans into comfort and community rather than the cold, transactional nature of standard fintech/SaaS. Incorporating warm terracotta, sage green, and stone-grey establishes a welcoming, home-like environment.

primary.description: Warm Terracotta - Friendly, energetic, used for primary CTAs like 'Add Expense' and 'Upgrade Premium'.

secondary.description: Moss/Sage Green - For success states, tasks completed, free tier health (e.g., '10/30 expenses used').

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8 for cards to let content breathe. Avoid cramped layouts, especially on mobile devices where 'thumb-friendly' design is essential.
spacing_and_layout.app_container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-stone-50 shadow-xl overflow-hidden relative
spacing_and_layout.admin_container: max-w-full min-h-screen bg-stone-100 flex flex-col md:flex-row
spacing_and_layout.card: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-sm p-6

components.button: rounded-xl font-medium transition-all duration-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-[#E07A5F] disabled:opacity-50
components.input: rounded-xl border-stone-200 bg-white focus:border-[#E07A5F] focus:ring-[#E07A5F] px-4 py-3

premium_modal.style: solid white background, p-8, rounded-3xl border border-[#E07A5F]/20 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden
premium_modal.features: list of benefits with moss green checkmarks
premium_modal.cta: w-full bg-[#E07A5F] text-white py-4 rounded-xl font-bold shadow-lg shadow-[#E07A5F]/30

limit_indicator.style: bg-stone-100 rounded-lg p-4 flex flex-col gap-2

images.description: Smiling Indonesian family - use for the 'Welcome' or 'Join Family' hero section header.
Cozy modern living room interior - use as a subtle overlay/background banner for the Premium Upgrade Modal to evoke domestic warmth.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upgrade-premium-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on Terracotta meets 4.5:1 WCAG AA standards.

admin_dashboard_specifics.layout: Control Room Grid (Dense, Functional, High clarity)
admin_dashboard_specifics.sidebar: w-64 bg-stone-900 text-stone-300. Active states in white with Terracotta border-left accent.
admin_dashboard_specifics.metrics_cards: bg-white p-6 border-l-4 border-[#81B29A] shadow-sm rounded-r-xl
admin_dashboard_specifics.data_table: Dense rows, left-aligned. Use pill-shaped status badges (e.g., Active = bg-green-100 text-green-800, Suspended = bg-red-100 text-red-800).
